slides.sub: Here's where each one is and when it's open.

slides.title: Parsippany Main Library
slides.body: Open 9 to 9 Monday to Thursday and 9 to 5 Friday and Saturday. Also open Sundays from September to May.

slides.title: Lake Hiawatha Branch
slides.body: Open 9 AM to 8 PM Monday to Thursday and 9 AM to 5 PM Friday and Saturday.

slides.title: Mount Tabor Branch
slides.body: Shorter hours: Tuesday 9 AM to 1 PM, Wednesday and Thursday 3 to 8 PM, Friday and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM.

slides.title: Your Parsippany library stops
slides.tip: Touring homes here? Time the drive from each house to the places you'd use every week.

caption:
Parsippany: you're probably missing this. One library card, 3 libraries in one town.

The Main Library at 449 Halsey Rd is open 9 AM to 9 PM Monday to Thursday and 9 AM to 5 PM Friday and Saturday, and it's also open Sundays from September to May. The Lake Hiawatha Branch at 68 Nokomis Ave is open 9 AM to 8 PM Monday to Thursday and 9 AM to 5 PM Friday and Saturday. The Mount Tabor Branch at 31 Trinity Pl keeps shorter hours and is closed Sunday and Monday. Your card also gets you free Wall Street Journal access and museum passes.

When you tour homes in Parsippany, time the drive from each house to the places you'd use every week.
